    // The valence (degree) of a vertex: how many undirected edges meet at it
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vertex_(graph_theory)#Vertex_degree).
    VertexValence(self: IMeshIncidence, vertex: VertexIndex): Integer
        => self.UndirectedEdgesOfVertex(vertex).Count;

    // The number of faces incident to a vertex. Equals VertexValence on a
    // closed manifold, and is one less on a boundary vertex.
    VertexFaceCount(self: IMeshIncidence, vertex: VertexIndex): Integer
        => self.FacesOfVertex(vertex).Count;

    // True for a vertex no face uses: a stray position in the array.
    IsIsolatedVertex(self: IMeshIncidence, vertex: VertexIndex): Boolean
        => self.FacesOfVertex(vertex).Count.IsZero;

    // The endpoint of an undirected edge that is NOT the given vertex.
    // Precondition: the vertex is one of the edge's two endpoints.
    OtherEndOfUndirectedEdge(self: IMeshIncidence, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex, vertex: VertexIndex): VertexIndex
    {
        var endpoints = self.VerticesOfUndirectedEdge(edge);
        return endpoints.A.Equals(vertex) ? endpoints.B : endpoints.A;
    }

    // The vertices one edge away from a vertex, in the order its incident edges
    // come back: the vertex-to-vertex row of the incidence structure.
    VerticesAdjacentToVertex(self: IMeshIncidence, vertex: VertexIndex): Array<VertexIndex>
        => self.UndirectedEdgesOfVertex(vertex)
            .Map(e => self.OtherEndOfUndirectedEdge(e, vertex));

    // How many faces an undirected edge borders: 0 for a wire edge, 1 on a
    // boundary, 2 in the interior of a manifold, more where it is non-manifold.
    FaceCountOfUndirectedEdge(self: IMeshIncidence, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): Integer
        => self.FacesOfUndirectedEdge(edge).Count;

    // True when an undirected edge borders no face at all: a wire edge.
    IsWireUndirectedEdge(self: IMeshIncidence, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): Boolean
        => self.FaceCountOfUndirectedEdge(edge).IsZero;

    // True when an undirected edge borders exactly one face: it lies on the
    // boundary of the surface.
    IsBoundaryUndirectedEdge(self: IMeshIncidence, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): Boolean
        => self.FaceCountOfUndirectedEdge(edge) == 1;

    // True when an undirected edge borders exactly two faces: the manifold
    // interior case.
    IsInteriorUndirectedEdge(self: IMeshIncidence, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): Boolean
        => self.FaceCountOfUndirectedEdge(edge) == 2;

    // True when more than two faces meet along one undirected edge, which no
    // 2-manifold allows (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IManifold).
    IsNonManifoldUndirectedEdge(self: IMeshIncidence, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): Boolean
        => self.FaceCountOfUndirectedEdge(edge) > 2;

    //==
    // IHalfEdge — constant-time walks over a half-edge structure
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doubly_connected_edge_list). Callers
    // must never pass -1; absence surfaces as a -1 IValue in the returned index.
    // (Twin is -1 on a boundary edge; IFace is -1 for a half-edge along a hole.)

    // The vertex a half-edge points at: the origin of its next half-edge.
    DestinationOf(self: IHalfEdge, halfEdge: HalfEdgeIndex): VertexIndex
        => self.OriginOf(self.NextOf(halfEdge));

    // True when this half-edge has an opposite half-edge (its edge is interior).
    HasTwin(self: IHalfEdge, halfEdge: HalfEdgeIndex): Boolean
        => self.TwinOf(halfEdge).IsPresent;

    // True when the undirected edge this half-edge is one side of lies on the
    // boundary — equivalently, when it has no twin.
    LiesOnBoundary(self: IHalfEdge, halfEdge: HalfEdgeIndex): Boolean
        => self.TwinOf(halfEdge).IsNone;

    // True when this half-edge runs along a hole rather than bordering a face.
    BordersHole(self: IHalfEdge, halfEdge: HalfEdgeIndex): Boolean
        => self.FaceOf(halfEdge).IsNone;

    // The next outgoing half-edge around the same origin vertex, advancing
    // counter-clockwise (faces wind CCW): the twin of the half-edge that arrives
    // at the origin. Returns -1 when that arriving half-edge is on the boundary
    // (no twin) — i.e. at the counter-clockwise end of an open fan.
    RotateAroundOrigin(self: IHalfEdge, halfEdge: HalfEdgeIndex): HalfEdgeIndex
        => self.TwinOf(self.PreviousOf(halfEdge));

    // The two endpoint vertices of a half-edge in its own direction: A is the
    // Origin, B is the Destination. NOT canonically ordered (A.Value may exceed
    // B.Value); take the twin's endpoints for the reverse direction.
    DirectedEndpointsOf(self: IHalfEdge, halfEdge: HalfEdgeIndex): VertexPair
        => (self.OriginOf(halfEdge), self.DestinationOf(halfEdge));

    //==
    // # Deformation bodies for the volumetric meshes
    //
    // The IDeformable3D obligations of the tetrahedral and hexahedral meshes in
    // `meshes.types.plato`: every shared vertex position is carried through
    // the mapping; the cell records are pure connectivity and pass through
    // unchanged. A strong enough mapping can invert cells (negative signed
    // volume), exactly as it can flip the winding of a surface face.

    // The IDeformable3D obligation: every vertex position carried through the
    // mapping, cells unchanged.
    Deform(self: TetrahedralMesh3D, mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): TetrahedralMesh3D
        => (self.Positions.Map(mapping), self.Cells);

    // The IDeformable3D obligation: every vertex position carried through the
    // mapping, cells unchanged.
    Deform(self: HexahedralMesh3D, mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): HexahedralMesh3D
        => (self.Positions.Map(mapping), self.Cells);

    //==
    // # The IHashable obligations
    //
    // A cell's identity is its corner indices in declaration order, matching the
    // face records above: IHashable must agree with
    // Equals, and two cells listing the same corners in a different order are
    // different values even where they enclose the same region.

    // The four corners folded in declaration order.
    Hash(self: TetrahedronCell): Integer
        => self.A.Value.Hash.CombineHash(self.B.Value.Hash)
            .CombineHash(self.C.Value.Hash).CombineHash(self.D.Value.Hash);

    // The eight corners folded in declaration order: the bottom quad, then the
    // top.
    Hash(self: HexahedronCell): Integer
        => self.A.Value.Hash.CombineHash(self.B.Value.Hash)
            .CombineHash(self.C.Value.Hash).CombineHash(self.D.Value.Hash)
            .CombineHash(self.E.Value.Hash).CombineHash(self.F.Value.Hash)
            .CombineHash(self.G.Value.Hash).CombineHash(self.H.Value.Hash);

    //==
    // # TetrahedralMesh3D — the boundary surface
    //
    // The IMesh3D obligation: the surface of a volume mesh is the set of
    // faces belonging to exactly ONE cell. An interior face is shared by two
    // tetrahedra and appears twice; a boundary face appears once.
    //
    // The multiplicity test is a scan of every candidate face against every
    // other, so extraction is quadratic in the cell count. A hash-grouped pass
    // would be linear, but grouping needs a keyed container this vocabulary does
    // not have (see LINT013 on IMap). Correct and slow beats fast and absent;
    // the worklist entry is plato-321.

    // The k-th face of a tetrahedron (k in 0..3), wound so its normal points OUT
    // of a positively oriented cell.
    TetrahedronFace(cell: TetrahedronCell, k: Integer): TriangleFace
        => k == 0 ? (cell.A, cell.C, cell.B)
         : (k == 1 ? (cell.A, cell.B, cell.D)
         : (k == 2 ? (cell.B, cell.C, cell.D)
                   : (cell.C, cell.A, cell.D)));

    // A face's orientation-free identity: its three corner indices in ascending
    // order, so the two windings of a shared interior face match.
    SortedFaceKey(face: TriangleFace): IntegerVector3 {
        var a = face.A.Value;
        var b = face.B.Value;
        var c = face.C.Value;
        var lowest = a.Min(b).Min(c);
        var highest = a.Max(b).Max(c);
        return (lowest, a + b + c - lowest - highest, highest);
    }
